name: aesthetic-print-designer
description: Develop original textile print directions, inspect repeats, and prepare design-stage print specifications.

interface.longDescription: Develop original fashion textile print directions from references and briefs, inspect repeat tiles, organize colour callouts, and prepare design-stage Print Specification Sheets. Includes local Python tools for repeat checks, colour analysis, and an English two-page PDF preset. Image generation requires a separate available tool; proprietary colour libraries are not bundled. Digital checks and colour candidates do not establish physical sampling or production approval. External writes and supplier transfers require a confirmed target and user authorization. Distributed under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; commercial use requires a separate written agreement.
capabilities: Repeat tile checks and visual review preparation
Colour callouts and design-stage print specification sheets
defaultPrompt: Review my references and propose three original textile print directions. Do not generate images yet.
Check my repeat tile and return an offset preview, a 3 x 3 preview, and a report. Keep the source unchanged.
Create a draft Print Specification Sheet for my selected artwork. Keep unknown fields and Pantone matching pending.
